cli.transport: CLI 1.0.98 real loopback-only synthetic turns establish separate trace/metric endpoint routing; OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER=none does not disable metrics. JSON/protobuf normalization and local replay are tested. Effective enterprise telemetry policy and authentication precedence remain unqualified; this is not installed managed capture.
cli.runtime_lifecycle: Runtime-owned short-lived trace receivers, same-UID scoped local header capabilities, durable activation receipts, bounded lease renewal/expiry and disable/stop revocation are implemented. The common managed launcher preserves coding status and strips FI credentials. The public Copilot adapter remains held pending source-specific launch/policy qualification.
remaining_activation_gap: No Copilot launch() is shipped. CLI 1.0.98 activates OTel only through COPILOT_OTEL_ENABLED=true, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT or COPILOT_OTEL_FILE_EXPORTER_PATH; a traces endpoint alone is not a documented activator, and COPILOT_OTEL_ENABLED is deliberately not in the generic trace-only overlay allowlist.

Activation also enables metrics. OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER=none still emitted metrics in real 1.0.98 runs, and there is no tested source setting that disables them; without an approved destination they would fall back to the default OTLP endpoint. This is the signal-isolation hold.

Effective-destination preflight must also cover COPILOT_OTEL_FILE_EXPORTER_PATH, COPILOT_OTEL_EXPORTER_TYPE, generic/per-signal headers and certificates, not only the generic and traces endpoint variables.
Built-in help says enterprise managed telemetry settings can enable OTel, but documents neither their location nor precedence over environment variables. This is the managed-settings hold.
cli.local_capability_scope: The per-launch bearer is delivered in OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_HEADERS and is inherited by shell, MCP and other processes Copilot starts. It authorizes only that loopback lease; same-user processes are outside this boundary and it is not an upstream key or sandbox.
cli.fixture_provenance: Derived from the existing docs fixture copilot-cli-1.0.98-default.jsonl. All native IDs, conversation IDs, names and times replaced with synthetic values; only reviewed operation/provider/model/tool labels and numeric token/multiplier values retained. SDK kind 0/2 converted to OTLP kind 1/3.
cli.identity: HMAC of native trace/span IDs; no cross-source aliases or transcript imports. Per-trace plan, common to all native descendants. Decode JSON hex and protobuf byte IDs with an explicit codec; transport changes preserve native/work/fact/plan identity.
cli.missing_session: hold; do not infer conversation from names, times or resources
cli.unregistered_labels: omitted; never infer provider from model name
cli.billing: github.copilot.cost retained as non-additive multiplier; github.copilot.nano_aiu retained as non-additive source billing units, never USD

harnesses.local: copilot-chat extension spans; requires exact released extension/VS Code versions and effective managed/environment/user-setting preflight
harnesses.copilot: copilot-chat wrapper parents github-copilot runtime in one trace; must qualify each producer separately
harnesses.terminal: independent github-copilot process; never infer editor parentage

vscode.resource_session_id: VS Code window identity is not the conversation; do not substitute it for span gen_ai.conversation.id

compatible_aggregation_rules: Only native chat spans own additive request usage
invoke_agent including subagents/wrappers has contribution=none, no standard usage or cost and no request count
Equal-value independent calls remain distinct; native replay keeps stable work/fact/plan IDs
Summary and multiplier fields never feed fallback pricing or usage reducers
Unknown cost is absent, never explicit zero
backend.release_hold: PR 3689 intentionally rejects additive contribution and reserved immutable identity/plan fields with FI_IMMUTABLE_ADMISSION_UNAVAILABLE. Its newer head removed the standalone detailed-cost ingestion hold, not the immutable-admission hold. The new runtime profile cannot be exported to that backend yet. Do not remove identity fields or approve a fabricated capability manifest to bypass the hold.
backend.remaining_acceptance: Immutable admission, immediate unique reads across all reducers/exports, cache-aware pricing, real staging persistence and UI verification
